import QleisliKernel.Qirf.RuntimeFormalActual
import QleisliKernel.Qirf.RuntimePreparedArm
import QleisliKernel.Qirf.RuntimeBodyDiscovery
open QleisliKernel QleisliKernel.Finite QleisliKernel.SourceTypes QleisliKernel.Qirf

private def probe (text : String) (second : Bool) : WorkM (List (String × Nat × String) × OperationDescription.Node) := do
  let identity : Semantics.Observation.Program := ⟨[⟨0,[0],1⟩],[],[],[0],[],.unitary⟩
  let selected : Semantics.Observation.Program := ⟨[⟨0,[0],1⟩,⟨1,[1],1⟩],[],[.pure (.quantumIf 0 1 2 3 [] [])],[2,3],[],.unitary⟩
  let artifact : Artifact := ⟨#[selected,identity],#[],#[("main",text)],0,none⟩
  let source ← RuntimeBodyDiscovery.prepareSource artifact "main" "route" {}
  let [.named first,.named last] := source.body.checked.events | throw .invalid
  let outer := if second then last else first
  let relay ← SourceRuntimeTrace.readNamedBody outer
  let [.named inner] := relay.checked.events | throw .invalid
  let choose ← SourceRuntimeTrace.readNamedBody inner
  let body := choose.checked
  let [.selection _ parsed _ selector target scope naturals ..] := body.events | throw .invalid
  let table ← QuantumArms.readArmsWithInstantiation body.signature.original body.signature.instantiation
    body.signature.supply parsed.keyword.span.startByte selector.basis target.basis (some naturals) scope
  let [left,right] := List.finRange table.arms.length | throw .invalid
  let empty : RuntimeContextRequest.Context := .mk [] [] [] [] []
  let provider : RuntimeProviderHeader.Request := (.pure 1,empty)
  let plain ← RuntimePreparedArm.prepare artifact source.catalogue table left [provider] []
  let arm ← RuntimePreparedArm.prepare artifact source.catalogue table right [provider] [[provider]]
  let rows := source.signature.sourceRows ++ relay.checked.summary.staticRows ++ body.summary.staticRows ++
    outer.target.sourceRows ++ inner.target.sourceRows ++ plain.rows ++ arm.rows
  let root ← Validity.checkRootFromRoots artifact #[0,1] rows (artifact.root :: plain.roots ++ arm.roots).eraseDups
  let .constructed _ _ _ markers _ ← RuntimePreparedArm.read arm root | throw .invalid
  let [entry] := markers.entries | throw .invalid
  let child ← RuntimeNativeSubject.readSubject entry.assertion
  let u ← RuntimeNativeSubject.readFormal child.child.cursor
  let w ← RuntimeNativeSubject.readFormal u.child.cursor
  return ([(u.name,u.position,u.header.name),(w.name,w.position,w.header.name)],w.child.cursor.node)

def main (args : List String) : IO Unit := do
  let [file] := args | throw (IO.userError "expected original source")
  let text ← IO.FS.readFile file
  for second in [false,true] do
    let (result,left) := (probe text second).run WorkProfile.qmatch.limit
    IO.println s!"second={second} result={repr result} spent={WorkProfile.qmatch.limit-left}"
    unless result.isOk do throw (IO.userError "expected native forwarded formal pair")

private def probe (text : String) : WorkM (List (Nat × Nat × String) × List (Nat × Nat) × List (Nat × Nat)) := do
  let identity : Semantics.Observation.Program := ⟨[⟨0,[0],1⟩],[],[],[0],[],.unitary⟩
  let selected : Semantics.Observation.Program := ⟨[⟨0,[0],1⟩,⟨1,[1],1⟩],[],[.pure (.quantumIf 0 1 2 3 [] [])],[2,3],[],.unitary⟩
  let artifact : Artifact := ⟨#[selected,identity],#[],#[("main",text)],0,none⟩
  let source ← RuntimeBodyDiscovery.prepareSource artifact "main" "route" {}
  let [.named outer] := source.body.checked.events | throw .invalid
  let relay ← SourceRuntimeTrace.readNamedBody outer
  let [.named inner] := relay.checked.events | throw .invalid
  let choose ← SourceRuntimeTrace.readNamedBody inner
  let body := choose.checked
  let [.selection _ parsed _ selector target scope naturals ..] := body.events | throw .invalid
  let table ← QuantumArms.readArmsWithInstantiation body.signature.original body.signature.instantiation
    body.signature.supply parsed.keyword.span.startByte selector.basis target.basis (some naturals) scope
  let [left,right] := List.finRange table.arms.length | throw .invalid
  let empty : RuntimeContextRequest.Context := .mk [] [] [] [] []
  let provider : RuntimeProviderHeader.Request := (.pure 1,empty)
  let plain ← RuntimePreparedArm.prepare artifact source.catalogue table left [provider] []
  let arm ← RuntimePreparedArm.prepare artifact source.catalogue table right (List.replicate 4 provider) [[provider]]
  let rows := source.signature.sourceRows ++ relay.checked.summary.staticRows ++ body.summary.staticRows ++
    outer.target.sourceRows ++ inner.target.sourceRows ++ plain.rows ++ arm.rows
  let root ← Validity.checkRootFromRoots artifact #[0,1] rows (artifact.root :: plain.roots ++ arm.roots).eraseDups
  let .constructed _ _ _ markers _ ← RuntimePreparedArm.read arm root | throw .invalid
  let [entry] := markers.entries | throw .invalid
  let child ← RuntimeNativeSubject.readSubject entry.assertion
  let u ← RuntimeNativeSubject.readFormal child.child.cursor
  let edges ← [0,1].mapM fun position => do
    let side ← RuntimeNativeSubject.readChild u.child.cursor position
    let w ← RuntimeNativeSubject.readFormal side.cursor
    return (position,side.cursor.binding.index.val,w.name ++ "." ++ w.header.name)
  let [duty] := source.pending.entries.filter (·.unconsumed) | throw .invalid
  let .demand invocation demand := duty.subject | throw .invalid
  let [_,app] := invocation.applications | throw .invalid
  let [composite] := app.operationActuals | throw .invalid
  return (edges,composite.suppliers.map (fun (index,origin) => (index,origin.offset)),
    demand.transported.subject.suppliers.map (fun (index,origin) => (index,origin.offset)))

def main (args : List String) : IO Unit := do
  let [file] := args | throw (IO.userError "expected original source")
  let text ← IO.FS.readFile file
  let (result,left) := (probe text).run WorkProfile.qmatch.limit
  IO.println s!"result={repr result} spent={WorkProfile.qmatch.limit-left}"
  unless result.isOk do throw (IO.userError "expected two independent native formal occurrences")

import QleisliKernel.Qirf.RuntimeBodyDiscovery
import QleisliKernel.SourceTypes.OperationSourceUses

open QleisliKernel QleisliKernel.Finite QleisliKernel.SourceTypes QleisliKernel.Qirf

private abbrev UseSummary :=
  List SourceOperation.Edge × String × String × Nat × String × List (String × Nat × Nat)

private def summarizeUse {sources caller callerName original instantiation entries environment scope genericState rootTokens}
    (use : @OperationSourceUses.Use sources caller callerName original instantiation entries environment scope genericState rootTokens) :
    UseSummary :=
  (use.path,use.formal.key.moduleName,use.formal.key.declarationName,use.formal.key.ordinal,
    use.formal.headerFormal.name,use.tokens.map fun token => (token.text,token.span.startByte,token.span.endByte))

private abbrev Summary := Nat × Nat × Nat × List String × List UseSummary

/-- This is a source-traversal component observation. No native action,
Meaning equality, ownership transition or accepted handle is claimed here. -/
private def probe (text : String) : WorkM Summary := do
  let artifact : Artifact := ⟨#[],#[],#[("main",text)],0,none⟩
  let original ← RuntimeBodyDiscovery.prepareSource artifact "main" "route" {}
  let [.named outer] := original.body.checked.events | throw .invalid
  let relay ← SourceRuntimeTrace.readNamedBody outer
  let [.named inner] := relay.checked.events | throw .invalid
  let [incoming] := inner.target.operationActuals.sourceActuals | throw .invalid
  let checked ← OperationSourceUses.readChecked incoming.checked
  return (outer.call.calleeOffset,inner.call.calleeOffset,incoming.index.val,
    incoming.actual.argument.tokens.map (·.text),checked.uses.map summarizeUse)

private def expected : Summary :=
  (654,563,0,
    ["provider","[","seed",",","then_op","(","W",",","power","(","W",",","0",")",")",",","W","]"],
    [([.actual 1,.child 0],"main","relay",1,"W",[("W",592,593)]),
     ([.actual 1,.child 1,.child 0],"main","relay",1,"W",[("W",600,601)]),
     ([.actual 2],"main","relay",1,"W",[("W",606,607)])])

def main (args : List String) : IO Unit := do
  let [file] := args | throw (IO.userError "expected the original mixed provider source")
  let text ← IO.FS.readFile file
  let (result,left) := (probe text).run WorkProfile.qmatch.limit
  IO.println s!"result={repr result}; work={WorkProfile.qmatch.limit-left}; left={left}"
  IO.println s!"expected={repr expected}"
  match result with
  | .error _ => throw (IO.userError "original mixed provider traversal refused")
  | .ok actual =>
    unless actual == expected do
      throw (IO.userError "original mixed paths, formal keys or use spans differ")
